verdict.rationale: FireHydrant is an incident-management platform with built-in AI features, so letting it connect to external MCP servers is a fair question to ask. The evidence only documents an official FireHydrant MCP server, which exposes FireHydrant's own API to other agents. That is the server role, a different story. Nothing shows FireHydrant's AI connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
